instruction: I want to configure Vim to use 4 spaces instead of tabs for indentation. Please look up how to set up Vim to use spaces for indentation and apply this configuration to my local Vim as the default behavior.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_spaces__3abb97cd.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
has_expandtab=false
has_tabstop=false
has_shiftwidth=false

if [ -f ~/.vimrc ]; then
    if grep -q "expandtab" ~/.vimrc; then
        has_expandtab=true
    fi
    if grep -q "tabstop=4" ~/.vimrc; then
        has_tabstop=true
    fi
    if grep -q "shiftwidth=4" ~/.vimrc; then
        has_shiftwidth=true
    fi
fi

if [ "$has_expandtab" = true ] && [ "$has_tabstop" = true ] && [ "$has_shiftwidth" = true ]; then
    echo "Vim Configured For 4 Spaces!"
else
    echo "Configuration incomplete"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_spaces__3abb97cd.sh
